h: Nollywood veteran Tito Harrison recounts how liver illness cost him his property
p: Veteran actor Tito Harrison has said a liver condition and a chronic ulcer left him bedridden and forced him to sell his cars and other property to pay hospital bills. He said he and his family later moved in with his mother-in-law and praised his wife for standing by him.
more: He shared his story in a recent interview.
Fans have flooded social media with messages of support.
Reports differ slightly on exactly what he sold.
